review_summary: Independently audited Question 9 (9702_w20_41) across all 4 answerable leaves (a, b(i), b(ii), c). Comprehensive verification confirms complete physics correctness and fidelity to Cambridge assessment standards: precise definition of magnetic flux with normal area condition (or sine of angle) for 9(a); rigorous 3-step physical explanation of electromagnetic induction in a transformer core (sinusoidal current creating varying flux, soft-iron core linking flux, changing flux linkage inducing secondary e.m.f.) for 9(b)(i); clear application of Faraday's law explaining non-constant induced e.m.f. due to time-varying rate of change of sinusoidal flux for 9(b)(ii); and complete justification for laminating the soft-iron core to reduce eddy currents and thermal energy dissipation for 9(c). Scaffolding provides progressive, non-giveaway hints, comprehensive walkthroughs, precise rubric criteria aligned with the official mark scheme (9/9 marks), and valid curriculum and knowledge registry mappings.
